blurbs.film:100 sunset: 100 Sunset follows two young Tibetan women navigating friendship, disappearance, and a quiet economy of survival in Toronto’s Parkdale neighbourhood.
blurbs.film:abominable: Yi is a teenager from Shanghai whose mother and grandma are overprotective of her in the absence of her father, while she yearns for adventure.
blurbs.film:age of innocence: The Age of Innocence tells the story of Newland Archer, whose engagement to an innocent socialite binds him to the codes and rituals of his upbringing.
blurbs.film:ali plumbs quiz night: Ali Plumb – that beardy movie guy off the internet with the glasses – is hosting a very special one-of-a-kind film quiz in honour of The Cinema Museum, with brand new rounds written to raise money for a very worthy cause!
blurbs.film:all about my mother: Pedro Almodóvar’s All About my Mother tells the story of how a woman (Cecilia Roth), struggling to get her life in order after her son’s (Eloy Azorín) death, is helped by a set of new friends.
blurbs.film:american doctor: Three American doctors volunteer in Gaza's overwhelmed hospitals.
blurbs.film:ann vickers with film historian kim: Join Women & Cocaine and our extra special guest, film historian Kim Luperi, author of Pre-Code Essentials, who is visiting us from across the pond for a screening of one of Pre-Code Hollywood’s most fascinatingly unruly films.
blurbs.film:arthur christmas: How can Santa deliver billions of presents to the whole world in just one night? With an army of one million combat-style Field Elves and a vast, state-of-the-art control centre under the ice of the North Pole!
blurbs.film:audition: Takashi Miike’s Audition follows a widower who orchestrates a staged casting process to meet a potential partner. The film centers on his fascination with the soft-spoken Asami, whose true nature gradually comes into question.
blurbs.film:basketcase: There’s a guy, he’s got a basket. Fore and more general boding permeate, social difficulties and problems with the neighbours ensue. The degradation and danger of Pre-Guilanni New York encapsulated in a wicker container. Cult low-rent trash comedy horror with a peculiar charm.
blurbs.film:changeling: The Changeling is included in our Haunted Christmas selection as a tribute to the director, the late Peter Medak.
blurbs.film:christmas ghost stories of john bow: As the nights draw in we invite you to a screening of the BBC’s celebrated A Ghost Story for Christmas films from the 1970s, written by acclaimed playwright and novelist John Bowen. The Treasure of Abbot Thomas (Lawrence Gordon Clark, 1974).
blurbs.film:chronicles of narnia the lion the w: Based on the first of the classic series of novels by CS Lewis, this fantasy adventure film follows four siblings: Peter, Susan, Edmund, and Lucy.
blurbs.film:cinema paradiso: A filmmaker recalls his childhood in a Sicilian village, where his love of cinema and friendship with a projectionist shaped his life and dreams.
blurbs.film:cleo snowtime: During the school holidays, Luc and Sophie decide to have a massive snowball fight to claim the rights to a fort.
blurbs.film:creature with the atom brain and i: Creature with the Atom Brain continues our ‘season within a season’ tribute to legendary producer Sam Katzman, and is teamed with the 1950’s sci-fi classic, I Married a Monster from Outer Space.
blurbs.film:dangerous youth: Ming-yeh Rawnsley (SOAS), co-editor of Taiwanese-Language Cinema: Rediscovered and Reconsidered (2024), the first English-language anthology devoted to Taiyupian.
blurbs.film:devils directors cut: Censored for more than half a century, Ken Russell’s visionary masterpiece returns to the big screen fully restored and cut to Russell’s direction - the first publicly released version of the film as intended by the filmmaker.
blurbs.film:dracula and they have changed their: We are delighted that acclaimed author, critic and broadcaster Kim Newman, who ‘cut his teeth’ at the Gothique Film Society, will be joining us to introduce two rare ‘Dracula’ adaptations.
blurbs.film:dull ice flower: UK premiere of the new restoration. Filmmaker in Focus: Mark Lee Ping-bing.
blurbs.film:early colour live: A collaboration between legendary magic lanternists Jeremy and Carolyn Brooker, and the Kennington Bioscope, this unique evening will feature a fantasia of colour from the era of the magic lantern through to early cinema.
blurbs.film:fatherland: Fatherland centres on the relationship between the Nobel Prize-winning writer Thomas Mann (Hanns Zischler) and his daughter Erika (Sandra Hüller) - actress, writer and rally driver.
blurbs.film:fjord: A Norwegian woman (Renate Reinsve) and her devout Romanian husband (Sebastian Stan) relocate with their five children to a remote coastal town.
blurbs.film:flight of the red balloon: Filmmaker in Focus: Mark Lee Ping-bing. Flight of the Red Balloon is Hou Hsiao-hsien’s first feature filmed outside Asia.
blurbs.film:ghost town: In a Japanese coastal town still haunted by the 2011 tsunami, a taxi becomes a moving confession booth.
blurbs.film:gozu: Moving between yakuza thriller, surrealist comedy and body horror, Gozu transforms the familiar codes of the gangster film into a delirious exploration of loyalty, identity and desire.
blurbs.film:horror for a cause save the cinema: Get ready for a spooky movie night to help keep The Cinema Museum alive with the cult classic Night of the Creeps!
blurbs.film:in my skin: In My Skin marked the striking debut of Marina de Van. The film follows Esther, a woman whose recovery from injury turns into a troubling fixation on her own flesh, where sensation and suffering become dangerously intertwined.
blurbs.film:josephine: Writer-director Beth de Araújo’s second feature is a deeply personal story, rooted in the filmmaker's own childhood experience of interrupting a sexual assault in Golden Gate Park with her father.
blurbs.film:julien donkey boy: Harmony Korine’s Julien Donkey-Boy follows a schizophrenic young man adrift within a deeply dysfunctional family. Its use of grainy, digital video textures and elliptical, fragmented imagery blends abrasive immediacy with moments of unexpected tenderness.
blurbs.film:la bola negra: La Bola Negra tells the story of three men whose lives are intimately connected through desire, pain and inheritance, across three different eras – 1932, 1937, and 2017.
blurbs.film:la marsellesa de los borrachos: A film crew travels through the roads and villages of northern Spain, retracing the clandestine journey of the Italian ethnomusicology group Cantacronache.
blurbs.film:macabre: On the 50th anniversary of the his death, a screening of the directorial debut of William Castle. A maniac attempts to drive a doctor over the edge by announcing that he has buried the physician’s daughter alive.
blurbs.film:man who fell to earth: Thomas Jerome Newton, a mysterious and complex personality, appears in New York. Despite his curiously frail physical presence, the strength of his intellect and scientific knowledge appear to transcend contemporary human experience.
blurbs.film:minotaur: Russia, 2022. Amidst the comfortable trappings of affluence and domesticity, corporate executive Gleb (Dmitriy Mazurov) finds himself under siege on all fronts. At home, he is haunted by suspicions that his increasingly distant wife Galina (Iris Lebedeva) is unfaithful.
blurbs.film:miracle on 34th street: A little girl discovers dreams do come true if you really believe. Six-year-old Susan (Mara Wilson) has doubts about childhood's most enduring miracle - Santa Claus.
blurbs.film:muppet christmas carol: Michael Caine joins Kermit the Frog, Miss Piggy, and all the hilarious Muppets in this merry, musical version of the Charles Dickens’ classic tale.
blurbs.film:naza: Shot at night on the rooftops of Tel Aviv, the film reveals in detail the systems behind Israel’s calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza.…
blurbs.film:on dangerous ground: A New York detective is living on the edge. Hardened and embittered by years of dealing with the lowest forms of criminal life, to cool off he is assigned a rural murder, where an encounter with a blind woman might turn his life around.
blurbs.film:one in a million: Filmed over ten years, One In A Million follows Israa from childhood to adulthood on an extraordinary journey from Syria to Germany - and back again.
blurbs.film:onwards and sideways: Tony Evans is deputy head of a primary school. Emma Kent is a musician and composer, and single mother of two daughters. Neither knows the other. until a startling encounter changes the course of their lives.
blurbs.film:phantom of the paradise: Faust, The Phantom of the Opera, The Picture of Dorian Grey are Frankensteined together by completely sane genius De Palma. Doo Wop, Surf, a grotesque based on Phil Spector, a Prison break, Glam rock and a pact with the Devil, this film really has it all.
blurbs.film:pinocchio subbed: CinemaItaliaUK in partnership with the Italian Cultural Institute present Matteo Garrone's Pinocchio. In this live-action adaptation of the beloved fairytale, old woodcarver Geppetto creates a wooden puppet, Pinocchio, who magically comes to life.
blurbs.film:programmers of tomorrow film festiv: The Cinema of Tomorrow presents an all-day film festival in which 3 people/collectives will screen films in public for the 1st time on the Cinema Museum big screen, and the audience gets 3 shows for the price of 1!!
blurbs.film:railway children: Adapted from the classic children’s novel by Edith Nesbit, The Railway Children is set in 1904, when three children from London move to the countryside after their father is falsely imprisoned.
blurbs.film:she devils on wheels: An all-female motorcycle gang hold motorcycle races, as well as terrorize the residents of a small Florida town, and clash with an all-male rival gang of hot-riders.
blurbs.film:silent laughter weekend: Silent Laughter Weekend 2026 is returning to its normal weekend length AND this year it promises to be absolutely jam-packed with wonderful comedic treasures.
blurbs.film:smallest shows on earth: A celebration of the little, lost, ‘fleapit’ cinemas of East London with social historian and Radio 4 presenter Alan Dein. Alan’s fascinating talk will include a screening of The Smallest Show on Earth (1957), accompanied by some theatrical surprises along the way.
blurbs.film:snow white and the seven dwarfs: For this first feature-length Disney Classic, the studio turned to the tales of the Brothers Grimm for inspiration.
blurbs.film:special day: On the day of a grand fascist parade, two isolated neighbours form a brief, intimate connection that reveals their quiet defiance and shared loneliness.
blurbs.film:stewart lee tells toby jones about: Join Comedian, writer, director and filmmaker Stewart Lee and his friend and actor Toby Jones as they show clips of, and discuss, Stewart’s favourite films – a lively night of exchanges and a chance to ask your questions from the floor.
blurbs.film:strawman: New restoration. Filmmaker in Focus: Mark Lee Ping-bing.
blurbs.film:sword in the stone: The legend of King Arthur gets the Disney treatment in this lively animated adventure. Only someone with honor and decency can pull the sword out of a massive stone.
blurbs.film:taipei story: Taipei Story is presented in memory of the late Tony Rayns, a longtime friend and champion of Edward Yang’s work, who voted this film for his Sight and Sound Greatest Films of All Time ballot three times in 2002, 2012 and 2022.
blurbs.film:time to live and the time to die: Filmmaker in Focus: Mark Lee Ping-bing. Inspired by filmmaker Hsiao-hsien Hou’s own childhood, this drama centers on Ah-Ha-Gu, a boy who comes of age during a tumultuous time in his family’s history.
blurbs.film:to hold a mountain: In the remote highlands of Montenegro’s Sinjajevina plateau, Gara and her thirteen-year-old daughter Nada return to their ancestral pastures every summer, where they herd animals, gather herbs and live in symbiosis with the mountain they call 'Mother.
blurbs.film:trouble every day: An American couple, played by Vincent Gallo and Tricia Vessey, go to Paris, ostensibly for their honeymoon; but in fact the husband has come to Paris to hunt down a neuroscientist and his wife, played by Béatrice Dalle, whom he once knew and is obsessed with.
blurbs.film:water mining and the cost of extrac: Brazil’s Mostra do Filme Marginal opens its second London edition at The Cinema Museum with the theme “Cinema and Environmental Emergency: Images of a Possible Future”.
blurbs.film:werewolf and the giant claw: Tonight’s films bring to an end our ‘season within a season’ tribute to legendary producer Sam Katzman, who made hundreds of low budget films and serials from the 30s right up to the 60s.
blurbs.film:wicker: On the outskirts of a village by the sea, lives a Fisherwoman; smelly, single, and perpetually ridiculed. One day, fed up with her stuffy, small-minded neighbours, she commissions herself a husband to be made from wicker.
blurbs.film:wild horse nine: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ.
blurbs.film:women on the verge of a nervous bre: Blending high melodrama with quirky, gazpacho-laden comedy, Women on the Verge of a Nervous Breakdown marked Pedro Almodóvar’s global breakthrough. Featuring Antonio Banderas and Rossy de Palma, this vivid black comedy highlights Almodóvar’s playful style.
blurbs.film:you can see everything: Thirty-four days before she’s sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a sceptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss.
blurbs.film:zombies of mora tau and the vampire: Zombies of Mora Tau opens our ‘season within a season’ look at the world of legendary producer Sam Katzman (1901-1973), whose speciality was low-budget genre films, and is joined by The Vampire, a stately Mexican film that predated Hammer’s Dracula by almost eight months.
